description: Stop this application's email at once, for a leaked token or a loop in the code. Its token is refused (403 suspended_api_key) until `email_resume`. The application itself keeps running. Needs the account token that `login` (or https://antideploy.com/agent.md) saves: a project key cannot do it. Tell the user it is paused.
name: email_pause
title: Stop the application's email now
